name: PATCH /api/voice-agent/stack-profiles/:profile_id - Update overrides, credentials or fallbacks
description: Updates an active stack profile: rename it, merge per-layer overrides onto the preset, or replace credential_refs / fallbacks. Every credential reference in the resulting profile is re-validated, so an update that points a layer at a missing or revoked binding is rejected with 422 CredentialInvalid — the same rule as create (deef80bf-b0ce-4295-9cf0-878c4f5bfd02#AC3). preset_key is immutable; archived profiles cannot be edited (409 Conflict). Every catalog layer (stt, llm_fast, llm_complex, tts) must use a certified speech catalog entry (322b0d69-8fde-47e0-aaf7-8c6420ed492b#AC3); otherwise the request is refused with 422 UncertifiedProvider naming each layer. allow_uncertified: true is an explicit opt-in that saves the profile flagged certified=false. The response carries certified and layer_certification, both evaluated live, so a later revocation shows on read.
